candidates.description: This vector represents common German action verbs in their base and inflected forms.
This vector represents negation, absence, and indefinite pronouns primarily in Germanic and Romance languages.
German possessive and definite determiners inflected across various genders, cases, and numbers.
This vector represents German subordinating conjunctions and relative pronouns that introduce dependent clauses.
This feature vector represents the concept of existence, being, and related philosophical or linguistic forms.
This feature vector represents German personal pronouns across various grammatical cases and persons.
First-person and second-person personal pronouns across multiple languages.
This vector represents German-language root words, lexical prefixes, and common nouns.
This feature vector represents the German first-person singular pronoun "Ich" and words starting with the letters "I" or "i".
This vector represents the concept of difference, variety, and distinction, particularly through German words related to "other," "different," and "specific."
